text: Calculate what the purchased cards provide.

Purchases modify eight named measures. The attributes cover passenger capacity, speed and communications distance. Other fields cover performance, protection, awareness, recovery and hazard-clearance methods. Each measure begins at zero. Apply each card effect with its sign, even when it reduces a value. This arithmetic describes the workshop exercise, not physical interaction between actual components.

items: Record each won card and actual auction price. You should see: Each purchase has an entry. If not: Do not use the printed starting price as paid cost.
Add all eight capability columns. You should see: One total per measure. If not: Keep negative intermediate and final values.
Sum all actual payments. You should see: One cost amount. If not: Check that no purchase was skipped.
Illustration: One purchase contributes five passenger places and another takes away two; the combined workshop capacity is three.

text: Sum the signed changes from every card bought, including repeated card instances.
Do not treat real radio ranges as additive outside this teaching model.
